questions.question: How can a local-first patient app satisfy the intended registration experience without introducing clinical cloud storage?
alternatives: Local profile registration only, clearly labelled
Optional true Sign in with Apple and tiny identity-only service
questions.falsifier: Account UI promises restored progress after reinstall but no clinical backup exists.

questions.question: Which storage/migration design preserves records with low writes and bounded resident history?
alternatives: SQLite adapter with paginated queries
Measured native alternative behind same repository interface
questions.falsifier: History loss, whole-array hydration or duplicate migration after injected crash.

questions.question: Do the frozen 6bc4d77 paths close R01-R03 on the integrated candidate?
alternatives: Accept only after current production journey replay
Reopen only the affected invariant if counterexample found
questions.falsifier: Conflicting event earns credit, schedule retains stale approval or mounted screen never becomes eligible.

questions.question: What programme may the independent patient safely use without an online treating team?
alternatives: Approved local programme package with explicit applicability/setup
Guided-only education/diary until the relevant programme is established
questions.falsifier: Selecting a procedure name unlocks unapproved protected movement.

questions.question: Which pose source and native presentation give useful feedback at the smallest measured resource cost?
alternatives: Keep current estimator
Apple Vision/Core ML candidate only after compatibility and evidence comparison
questions.falsifier: New model changes landmark/angle meaning without new method identity or validated equivalence.
questions.next_experiment: Evaluation receipt adapter; capability/coordinate probe; bounded capture migration choice; same-sequence optional-channel ablation. No patient-entered stick length.

questions.question: Can complete native patient journeys be reproduced in both appropriate lanes and their artifacts scrutinised?
alternatives: Hosted macOS CI with deterministic native fixtures and image artifacts
questions.falsifier: Only web screenshots or green test status are available.

questions.question: How does interval scheduling handle sleep, abandoned sessions, timezone and declined notifications?
alternatives: Explicit local calendar window and approved interval anchor; OS notification optional
questions.falsifier: Missed reminders accumulate treatment dose or the app exercises outside the approved window.

questions.question: What may count as longitudinal clinical improvement rather than a numerical difference?
alternatives: Show qualified compatible observations without automatic improvement label
Add claims only with independent repeatability/reference evidence
questions.falsifier: Synthetic fixtures or high landmark confidence are used as proof of clinical accuracy.

questions.question: Which toolchain pin yields identical local/hosted Pod metadata without weakening strict installation?
alternatives: Pin and qualify the existing 1.16.2 toolchain
Deliberately migrate local and hosted locks to another reviewed toolchain
questions.falsifier: A clean runner modifies the lock or strict installation is bypassed.

questions.question: Does a failed storage read leave existing records intact through navigation/retry/restart?
alternatives: Explicit hydration-error write barrier before migration
Transactional store with source-preserving migration and read recovery
questions.falsifier: An errored read is treated as truly empty and new persistence destroys the original.

questions.question: Which endpoint policy balances meaningful ROM, selection bias, usable coverage and between-setup repeatability?
alternatives: best-valid endpoint
typical valid endpoint
standardized stable endpoint
questions.falsifier: More noisy observations create claimed improvement without a real change.

questions.question: Can the patient and later surgeon/physio interpret an export without a connected-care backend?
alternatives: Patient-owned appointment summary plus versioned small export
Defer remote linkage while preserving origin and units
questions.falsifier: Self-report becomes clinician-verified activity, unavailable becomes zero or the screen implies active monitoring.

phone_architecture.title: Device-assisted capture without extra patient setup
phone_architecture.scope: Architecture/design analysis, not an ATAM stakeholder workshop, independent review, sensor experiment or clinical validation. Six Hats are explicit thinking perspectives, not six independent agents. Counterfactual responses below are proposed acceptance oracles, not executed device results.
phone_architecture.owner_input: No patient-entered stick length; use available recent-phone capabilities to improve accuracy without a complicated internal stack. Preserve clinician-selected variant, permitted assistance, realistic caudal leeway and a simple mobile result.
phone_architecture.source_distinctions: Owner direction is binding product intent. Reviewer suggestions remain attributed proposals. Platform manuals establish available APIs, not app integration or anatomical accuracy. Alternatives, priorities and thresholds-not-yet-set are receiving-agent judgments.

sources.supports: Scenarios, utility tree, risks, sensitivity and trade-off points structure architecture assessment.
sources.limits: This solo analysis does not claim stakeholder voting or formal ATAM certification.

sources.supports: Facts, feelings, caution, benefits, alternatives and process control are distinct perspectives.
sources.limits: No patient emotion or preference is established by adopting a perspective.

sources.supports: Intrinsic delivery depends on both the input format and output.
sources.limits: Not universal per device; intrinsics alone do not recover arbitrary object depth.

sources.supports: Active format determines available depth formats and delivers per-pixel depth/disparity.
sources.limits: Availability is not usable quality at the target joint.

sources.supports: One capture session can synchronize video/depth and supply calibration; sample uses rear LiDAR.
sources.limits: Rear LiDAR does not supply front-view patient depth; example precision is not clinical accuracy.

sources.supports: Apple recommends unfiltered depth for computer vision; filtered depth fills holes.
sources.limits: This recommendation does not validate a joint-centre estimator.

sources.supports: OS-processed gravity/attitude/rotation/user acceleration can be consumed.
sources.limits: No inertial inference of shoulder motion from a stationary phone.

sources.supports: Motion timestamps are seconds since device boot.
sources.limits: They must not simply be equated to video PTS or wall time without a mapped clock contract.

sources.supports: V5 documents Nitro, modular outputs, depth streaming and different worklet integration.
sources.limits: Maintainer performance/crash claims do not establish compatibility or reliability for this app.

sources.supports: Upstream now says V4 is no longer actively maintained and points to a V4 snapshot.
sources.limits: No assertion that V4 is currently insecure; maintenance status changes the migration trade-off.

sources.supports: Depth uses worklet dependencies and requires disposal or the capture pool can stall.
sources.limits: No proof that RGB/depth clocks are aligned by merely attaching two output callbacks.

sources.supports: Depth exposes pixel format, validity, orientation and timestamp.
sources.limits: Invalid, stale, mirrored or differently oriented depth is not an interchangeable pixel array.

sources.supports: Vision 3D supplies 17 joints or none for the most prominent person; depth can help; reference-height fallback exists.
sources.limits: Not partial-joint observability evidence. Joint set/scale and helper-person capture need qualification.

sources.supports: MediaPipe outputs image/world landmarks and may ignore live input while busy.
sources.limits: Visibility is not a calibrated angle error and nominal input fps is not output coverage.

sources.supports: No stick-length entry and low-burden phone-capability direction were recorded after the owner message.
sources.limits: Comment is intent/research, not application implementation or clinical acceptance.

elements.title: No-entry geometry and unmeasured size
elements.decision: Select scale-independent angles/body-normalised displacement; unknown stick length is a latent nuisance variable, not a missing patient form field.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: A patient brings an ordinary stick without a measured length.
atam.response: Proceed with permitted activity; use stick constraints only when observable; never substitute fixed anatomy or require an equipment measurement.
atam.measure: Zero new length/marker/calibration tasks; separate angle error and availability under different stick sizes, distances and grips.
atam.sensitivity: Depth observability and hand/shaft association, not centimetre precision.
atam.tradeoff: Removing a setup task improves usability but removes a possible scale input; optional depth/temporal constraints may compensate without guaranteeing identifiability.

hats.white: Angles are invariant to uniform 3D scale; an unknown-length 2D segment alone does not fix its 3D orientation.
hats.red: Hypothesis: tape/length forms feel burdensome or imply the patient is at fault; confirm through task observation.
hats.black: A guessed size or standard shoulder width can masquerade as independent calibration.
hats.yellow: No ruler, typing or special stick is necessary for guided care; ratios can still be informative.
hats.green: Combine visible shaft direction, unchanged rigidity and natural motion with depth where usable; retain multiple interpretations when ambiguous.
hats.blue: Make absent length a positive test case; postpone metric distances unless scale is actually supported.

counterfactuals.intervention: Remove all stick dimensions
counterfactuals.expected: No setup request; use scale-independent evidence or withhold affected output
counterfactuals.falsifier: Any hidden default length, forced entry or newly permitted exercise.

counterfactuals.intervention: Change grip along a rigid shaft
counterfactuals.expected: Do not move the inferred wrist to the tip; uncertainty or association may change
counterfactuals.falsifier: Angle changes solely because the grip-to-tip offset changed without modelling it.

elements.title: Calibrated coordinates and aligned time
elements.decision: Adopt one versioned capture geometry/time envelope before sensor fusion; preview coordinates are not metric camera coordinates.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Mirroring, crop, zoom/lens, orientation, exposure timing or callback latency changes during a Check.
atam.response: Transform once from known source to target; align capture timestamps to a documented monotonic clock; reject stale/mismatched generations and invalidate the affected interval.
atam.measure: Synthetic projections and delayed/dropout event tests preserve anatomical sign; no mixed calibration IDs/timebases admitted. Record capture-to-feedback p50/p95 and missing coverage.
atam.sensitivity: Intrinsics reference resolution, extrinsics, digital crop/stabilisation, focus/lens policy and cross-clock mapping uncertainty.
atam.tradeoff: Correct transformation/time metadata is modest structural cost; treating display coordinates as anatomy is simpler but invalid for fusion.

hats.white: Intrinsic support depends on active format/output; Core Motion and frame timestamps are not assumed to share units/origin.
hats.red: Hypothesis: a stable-looking but wrong-side overlay undermines trust more than a brief unavailable state.
hats.black: Double mirroring, stale depth, rolling-shutter/motion blur or changed stabilisation can create convincing false motion.
hats.yellow: One frame identity and transform contract reduces downstream special cases and makes replays reproducible.
hats.green: Preserve native pixels; transform sparse landmark coordinates, mapping metadata and uncertainty rather than recopying full images.
hats.blue: Make coordinate/time correctness a prerequisite to combining channels; no magical accuracy claim from intrinsics.

counterfactuals.intervention: Mirror/crop the preview only
counterfactuals.held_fixed: Same physical input and anatomical side
counterfactuals.expected: Only overlay presentation changes; measured side and rotation sign agree
counterfactuals.falsifier: A second mirror reverses side, or the result changes with UI layout.

counterfactuals.intervention: Deliver an older depth frame after a new RGB frame
counterfactuals.expected: Stale pair withheld; missing sample breaks coverage according to the method
counterfactuals.falsifier: Receipt time or latest-value cache is substituted for matching capture time.

elements.title: OS-fused motion and setup stability
elements.decision: Use available processed motion as an optional setup-change witness; never as a complete phone-position or mattress-plane measurement.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Phone is nudged, translated without changed tilt, rotated in yaw, or motion input is unavailable.
atam.response: Invalidate measurements on established setup change; combine with usable visual evidence; preserve activity. When stability cannot be confirmed, expose unknown and reacquire without forcing a new therapeutic movement.
atam.measure: Translation/yaw/tilt controls and denied/unavailable motion tests; zero false unchanged-placement claim from gravity alone. Quantify false reacquisition and setup burden.
atam.sensitivity: Reference frame choice, motion-sample age and cue hysteresis vs immediate measurement withholding.
atam.tradeoff: Motion can cheaply catch disturbances but cannot recover every translation; aggressive prompts cause repeated reaching.

hats.white: Core Motion provides processed orientation/motion; constant gravity is compatible with translation and yaw about gravity.
hats.red: Hypothesis: repeated repositioning during a painful activity causes abandonment; observe actual reaches, not just taps.
hats.black: Camera movement mistaken for body drift, or a rigid bed-plane assumption, defeats repeatability.
hats.yellow: Existing OS fusion avoids a custom inertial filter stack and reduces some setup failures.
hats.green: Use a shared setup generation plus visual-relative geometry; retain guided Do if the optional Check loses support.
hats.blue: Reuse the existing framing/cue mechanism; gate measurements promptly and debounce only non-safety presentation.

counterfactuals.intervention: Translate the phone horizontally at unchanged attitude
counterfactuals.held_fixed: Patient remains in the same pose
counterfactuals.expected: Gravity alone cannot certify unchanged setup; visual/context evidence or unknown state required
counterfactuals.falsifier: The baseline is declared valid solely because the gravity vector matched.

counterfactuals.intervention: Disable motion delivery
counterfactuals.held_fixed: Same allowed activity and RGB frames
counterfactuals.expected: No crash or demand for a calibration movement; use only separately qualified remaining evidence
counterfactuals.falsifier: Zero motion substituted for missing motion or guided activity denied.

elements.title: Optional synchronized depth
elements.decision: Evaluate front TrueDepth where the active format supports it; rear LiDAR only in a separately appropriate view. Hardware presence is not stream usability.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Depth is absent, stale, filtered, low confidence, out of range, or samples bedding instead of the intended anatomy.
atam.response: Use registered fresh depth only for supported visible surfaces; keep depth/disparity units and calibration explicit. Do not fill a hidden joint with mattress depth. Fall back only to a qualified RGB method after required interval change.
atam.measure: Paired reference error/coverage and false acceptance; depth-only ablation; no unsupported centimetres or invented depth in holes. Report latency/memory and usable depth coverage at actual bedside distance.
atam.sensitivity: RGB-depth registration/extrinsics, timestamp skew, range, disparity conversion, filtering, occlusion and surface-to-joint assumptions.
atam.tradeoff: Depth may improve out-of-plane information but can lower frame rate, increase heat and fail where its benefit is needed; adaptive use is not monotonic improvement.

hats.white: AVFoundation supports compatible depth streams; Apple distinguishes filters and demonstrates synchronized delivery. No device was tested in this task.
hats.red: Hypothesis: an expensive phone returning fewer numbers feels defective; explain unmeasurable data without implying bad recovery.
hats.black: A valid surface map can be an invalid joint estimate; filled holes and thin-object boundaries are hazardous.
hats.yellow: Front depth may add information without turning the phone around or asking for stick length.
hats.green: Start with sparse regional depth support and preserve nulls; compare raw versus filtered, with filtering provenance.
hats.blue: Select measured benefit, not device marketing. No LiDAR/TrueDepth requirement for the patient MVP.

counterfactuals.intervention: Remove depth or move subject beyond usable depth
counterfactuals.held_fixed: Same permissions, activity and RGB recording
counterfactuals.expected: Continue Do; evaluate a qualified baseline method or withhold the Check
counterfactuals.falsifier: Silent mixture with stale depth, coercive rear-camera move or fabricated zero.

counterfactuals.intervention: Depth pixel under a predicted joint belongs to mattress
counterfactuals.expected: Reject surface association for that joint; other valid outputs may survive
counterfactuals.falsifier: Nearest depth substituted into the joint merely because the map is dense.

elements.title: Unmarked stick as an optional constraint
elements.decision: Prototype small region-of-interest shaft/hand tracking only for stick variants; no mandatory tip visibility, markers, known length or second full-body model.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: A plain stick is partially hidden, slips in the hand, has flex, or resembles a background rail.
atam.response: Track association/rigidity hypotheses through natural movement; reject changed grip/bent object assumptions; separate adjunct loss from whole-pose loss. The tip is never the wrist by default.
atam.measure: Skeleton-only versus adjunct paired errors/availability; adversarial rails, sleeve, covered ends and sliding grip. Report extra processing and false association.
atam.sensitivity: Projected shaft length, contrast, hand occlusion, rigidity and direction ambiguity.
atam.tradeoff: A cheap line tracker can add useful constraints but weak association worsens results; support visible segments rather than demanding extra patient framing.

hats.white: Current pose landmarks are not object tracking. Source debate proposed known length/markers; the owner rejected extra setup.
hats.red: Hypothesis: being told the household stick is wrong adds avoidable frustration; observe perceived burden.
hats.black: Two wrong but correlated estimates can agree; line tracking is not independent confirmation of a pose-model prior.
hats.yellow: A rigid visible shaft can stabilise direction or reject some implausible pose estimates at low cost.
hats.green: Try edges/lines in hand-adjacent regions; compare to using no stick information, retaining uncertainty.
hats.blue: Do not build a marker product. Keep the adjunct only if it beats baseline under realistic unmarked-stick conditions.

counterfactuals.intervention: Replace visible stick by a parallel bed rail
counterfactuals.expected: Do not bind the rail to the hands; abstain when ambiguous
counterfactuals.falsifier: A confident angle appears through mistaken object association.

counterfactuals.intervention: Hide both tips but leave shaft near hands
counterfactuals.expected: Partial shaft may support direction; do not invent endpoints or demand new equipment
counterfactuals.falsifier: Both tips assumed necessary for guided care or a fabricated length is used.

elements.title: One production pose engine
elements.decision: Retain the current engine as baseline; evaluate Apple Vision or another supported provider sequentially as alternatives, not always-on consensus.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Engine/model/provider revision changes, or a helper becomes the most prominent person.
atam.response: Record provider/model/configuration and subject track per interval; reject subject transfer; require new interval/method compatibility when switching. Do not equate all returned joints to all joints observed.
atam.measure: Cross-engine same-sequence comparison; no mixed-model endpoint; helper intrusion and obscured-arm cases. Resource profile per provider.
atam.sensitivity: Joint definitions, inferred scale, all-or-none output, smoothing and provider revision.
atam.tradeoff: A native provider may reduce dependencies but alters landmark meanings and portability; parallel voting increases resource use without independent evidence.
atam.artifact: pose provider and patient track identity

hats.white: MediaPipe gives predicted image/world points; Apple Vision 3D returns 17 joints or none and has reference-height fallback.
hats.red: Hypothesis: one coherent result feels more trustworthy than competing skeletons; that does not justify hiding failures.
hats.black: Most-prominent-person selection can switch to a helper, and correlated pose priors can share error.
hats.yellow: A provider seam permits replacement and comparison without rebuilding patient UI or clinical rules.
hats.green: Use an offline/evaluation provider adapter, one engine at a time, and evaluate only required outputs.
hats.blue: Do not replace the engine on API attractiveness alone; require reference-linked benefit and regression parity.

counterfactuals.intervention: Switch Full to Lite mid-endpoint
counterfactuals.expected: Close/invalidate affected interval unless qualified equivalence policy explicitly permits it; retain model provenance
counterfactuals.falsifier: The endpoint joins both models under unchanged method identity.

counterfactuals.intervention: Helper becomes more prominent than patient
counterfactuals.expected: Withhold/reconfirm affected tracking; do not move the episode to the helper
counterfactuals.falsifier: A new skeleton silently populates the patient best series.

elements.title: Capture integration and maintenance
elements.decision: Prefer a maintained single capture stack if compatibility is demonstrated; compare a bounded V5 migration against a bounded current-owner extension before installing. No competing camera session or indefinite V4 fork.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: New depth API requires different worklets/Nitro and may not fit RN0.73.2/MediaPipe0.6.0.
atam.response: Inventory exact transitive/native interfaces; qualify RGB parity, synchronized depth, build locks and rollback in a bounded spike. Preserve current known-good branch and first patient journey.
atam.measure: Pass the same native guided/player/storage/pose tests; one camera owner; explicit resolved dependency set and native receipt. Decision records maintenance burden and omitted hardware.
atam.sensitivity: Existing frame-plugin ABI, native build and timestamp access, OS minimum and migration scope.
atam.tradeoff: V5 reduces long-term custom glue but incurs migration cost; extending unmaintained V4 may be smaller today but create larger future debt.

hats.white: Locked app uses VisionCamera4.7.2; upstream labels V4 no longer actively maintained. V5 changes output/worklet contracts.
hats.red: Hypothesis: regressions in a working routine cost more patient confidence than a delayed optional sensor feature.
hats.black: Treating V5 docs as installed capability or starting a second AVCapture/AR session causes integration and custody failures.
hats.yellow: Supported modular outputs may retire bespoke glue and supply explicit geometry/buffer lifecycle.
hats.green: Compare maintained migration, narrow extension, and deferring depth; same evaluation contract in all three.
hats.blue: Make a compatibility/prototype decision before either migration or extension; no blanket upgrade in this task.

counterfactuals.intervention: Assume current V4 hook supports V5 depth API
counterfactuals.expected: Capability remains unknown/unsupported until compiled and exercised
counterfactuals.falsifier: Documentation presence is used as integration evidence.

counterfactuals.intervention: Migration requires broad app rewrite
counterfactuals.expected: Defer depth if necessary; retain working baseline and record maintenance decision
counterfactuals.falsifier: A second camera stack or global dependency rewrite becomes an implicit requirement.

elements.title: Buffers, scheduling and recovery
elements.decision: Use one capture owner, one pose engine and bounded native buffers; extend current throttling only from measured need. Keep acquisition gaps visible.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Thermal pressure, skipped frames, held buffer, stale callback, background transition or native termination occurs.
atam.response: Release buffers on success/error/cancellation; discard stale generations; preserve acknowledged activity. Degrade only through qualified paths, no unbounded restart loop. After process death recover on next launch, not a promised last-chance JS save.
atam.measure: Peak/retained RSS and energy during matched cycles; capture-to-feedback age; drop coverage; zero old-generation callbacks admitted and no duplicate saved event. Existing 30-cycle fixture is engineering stress, not clinical sample size.
atam.sensitivity: Queue length, buffer lifetime, thread affinity, inference rate, model switches and app lifecycle.
atam.tradeoff: Fresh low-rate evidence can be more useful than dense stale results; energy savings cannot silently count missing time as observed.
atam.artifact: buffers, measurement freshness and acknowledged activity

hats.white: MediaPipe live input can be dropped while busy; VisionCamera depth buffers require disposal. Existing adaptive model selection is already implemented.
hats.red: Hypothesis: smooth preview with delayed coaching is more confusing than explicit temporary unavailability.
hats.black: Buffer exhaustion, stale-result reuse or a JS recovery promise after native crash hides data-loss risk.
hats.yellow: Small lifecycle boundaries reuse platform memory/compute support and keep UI responsive.
hats.green: Start with one in-flight task/latest admissible frame and bounded trace; add controls only to address observed bottlenecks.
hats.blue: Measure on the oldest selected supported iPhone and a depth-capable one; retain activities across detector-only failures.

counterfactuals.intervention: Slow inference while preview stays smooth
counterfactuals.expected: Old output cannot remain current; gaps counted and timestamp age exposed to method gate
counterfactuals.falsifier: Nominal fps or repeated latest pose is treated as continuous observation.

counterfactuals.intervention: Cancel during depth callback or kill process after acknowledged save
counterfactuals.expected: Owned buffers release where process survives; next launch recovers acknowledged event without duplication
counterfactuals.falsifier: Unreleased pool grows, or in-memory completion masquerades as durable after termination.

elements.title: Evaluation adapter, provenance and comparisons
elements.decision: Build the receipt-aware isolated evaluation adapter first. Keep origin, purpose, validity, uncertainty and storage receipt distinct; no incoming record registers a method.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Synthetic/replay/live-study results arrive with asserted saved flags, an unregistered method, changed sensors or a revoked consent scope.
atam.response: Translate validated paired observations without recomputing endpoints; derive saving from receipt; keep evaluation data out of patient history and block unauthorized capture/export. Method compatibility is explicit, not accidental field matching.
atam.measure: No evaluation-to-patient leakage, no incoming-method self-registration, repeat-safe save/reopen, no cross-series best after method/band/provider changes. Trace retention/export scope reviewed.
atam.sensitivity: Schema provenance, registry ownership, origin labels, receipt derivation and method equivalence.
atam.tradeoff: Compact records support future surgeon/physio review but excessive raw traces increase privacy/storage cost. Too many series fragments reduce utility; equivalence must be proven rather than assumed.
atam.stimulus_source: incoming record, registry and storage service
atam.artifact: evaluation adapter, receipt and comparison series

hats.white: Existing selector separates modes but evaluation currently expects synthetic origin; live research needs an explicit truthful origin path.
hats.red: Hypothesis: patients interpret best as a goal and saved as backed up; test meaning rather than preference alone.
hats.black: A guessed joint or hidden study result can become patient-authoritative through a permissive adapter.
hats.yellow: One recorded source can drive number, diagram and compatible history with fewer divergent rules.
hats.green: Use typed compact channels and explicit reason codes; separate governed short RGB/reference retention from landmark replay.
hats.blue: Keep patient registry empty until scoped qualification; no portal, automatic progression or research sensor collection in ordinary Do.

counterfactuals.intervention: Incoming record says saved and supplies its own method
counterfactuals.expected: No receipt/registration borrowed from payload; no patient number
counterfactuals.falsifier: Payload turns itself into a qualified saved result.

counterfactuals.intervention: Upgrade phone/provider or widen allowance
counterfactuals.expected: New series or explicit proven compatibility; no automatic improvement attribution
counterfactuals.falsifier: New hardware alone creates a best in an old incompatible series.

elements.title: Low-cognition patient feedback and optionality
elements.decision: The system selects supported evidence; patients do not select sensors. Preserve one relevant cue, visible uncertainty and compact paired result with optional history detail.

atam.environment: iPhone-first local patient app and separately authorised evaluation build; clinical variant fixed
atam.stimulus: Patient is side-lying, cannot see the screen, declines an optional capability, or tracking fails during a permitted exercise.
atam.response: Retain spoken/written guidance and reachable Stop; do not force reaching, markers, length or a new movement to obtain a number. A Check can reacquire only when necessary; Do remains permitted by its programme.
atam.measure: Zero new calibration tasks; record setup/reach time and interpretation accuracy/confident errors on actual phones. No safety cue delayed by non-safety hysteresis and no missing-to-zero display.
atam.sensitivity: Cue wording/priority, screen viewing distance, accessibility scale, reference versus clinical zero.
atam.tradeoff: Less visual clutter reduces decisions but concealing unavailable status gives false reassurance; approximate results need meaningful qualifiers.

hats.white: Owner wants approximate rotation, schematic, previous and episode-best with minimal interpretation. Existing guided Do does not require camera.
hats.red: Hypothesis: people may feel judged by warnings or assume a bigger historical number must be beaten; no patient finding is claimed.
hats.black: A successful sensor negotiation can still create an unusable bedside workflow or an unearned reassurance.
hats.yellow: Same simple routine can work across phones; capable hardware improves evidence without technical menus.
hats.green: Use context-specific post-Check information and one optional explanation, compare with simpler alternatives in comprehension tasks.
hats.blue: Accept improvements only when added information is useful without new patient duties; optional sensor loss never rewrites a prescription.

counterfactuals.intervention: Disable all optional channels but retain authorised guided plan
counterfactuals.expected: Do still works with truthful record; Check uses qualified RGB or unavailable
counterfactuals.falsifier: Treatment is blocked solely for absent sensor/marker/length.

counterfactuals.intervention: User interprets best as a target despite attractive schematic
counterfactuals.expected: Redesign/retest wording and hierarchy; no preference-only acceptance
counterfactuals.falsifier: Visual appeal or green automation substitutes for understanding.

inspected_code.finding: Existing one-pose hook uses GPU and adaptive Full/Lite. New result selector is isolated and patient registry empty. This task does not prove calibration/motion/depth integration.

utility_tree.acceptance: No unsupported patient result, hidden method change, wrong-side assignment or fabricated observation interval.
No length/marker/calibration task; clinically permitted Do remains usable independently of optional measurement.
Preserve activity through measurement loss; quantify fresh-result latency, retained memory, energy and reacquisition burden.
One camera/pose owner; exact dependencies and rollback; platform capability differences do not leak into clinical meaning.
Optional adjunct stays only after paired evidence shows worthwhile benefit at acceptable resource cost.

risk_themes: False precision: predicted depth, visible surfaces, rig geometry and clinical joint angle are not equivalent; correlated channels can agree while wrong.
Burden transfer: removing a form must not introduce tape, room scans, repeated reaches or expensive-phone dependence.
Integration debt: more sensors/engines/callbacks multiply transform/time/lifetime errors; V4 maintenance status makes indefinite custom extensions costly.
History contamination: automatic fallback, model updates, research origin or an asserted save flag can manufacture progress unless authority and provenance are retained.
non_risks_within_scope: Current no-entry decision needs no new therapeutic dose or allowance. Existing guided activity can continue to deliver value while methods are evaluated.
A versioned capture/provider adapter can reuse the tested selector rather than create a second comparison algorithm. This is a design mitigation, not implemented sensor validation.

choices.decision: Selected evaluation baseline and first sensing enhancement
choices.condition: Correct transformation/time coverage before claiming multisensor gain.

choices.option: Optional synchronized front depth and stick adjunct
choices.condition: Same active camera/session; unmarked/no-entered-length; independent paired references; useful benefit without added patient setup.

choices.decision: Preferred direction to investigate, not an approved upgrade
choices.condition: Current upstream V4 maintenance status favours it, but exact RN/MediaPipe/plugin compatibility and native RGB/depth parity must pass first.
Useful public integration seam, no competing session, named maintenance owner and retirement plan; otherwise defer depth rather than maintain an open-ended fork.

choices.option: Parallel pose ensemble, automatic calibration routine, always-on sensors
choices.condition: Reconsider only on a named evidence gap and quantified benefit; no increase in patient work by default.

experiments.purpose: Ablate information sources, not compare attractive demos. Physical/clinical experiment is planned and unexecuted.
arms: B: same RGB plus supported calibrated geometry/time and OS motion
C: B plus synchronized usable depth, on compatible capture
D: B or C plus unmarked-stick constraint where the prescribed variant uses it
design: Use paired reference-linked sequences and stable clinical variants; candidates never receive known stick length. Researchers may retain measured lengths only for independent truth/instrumentation.

Hold participant/side/variant and endpoint protocol constant; freeze candidate policies on development cases, then evaluate independent participants/repeat-day self-setup. Do not tune on the final test result.

Report both error on issued results and the full eligible-attempt denominator: coverage, false acceptance/withholding, per-subgroup and per-view results. Report conditional depth-available and whole-workflow performance separately.

Participants and sessions, not thousands of correlated frames, determine independent sampling. Predefine intended-use accuracy/repeatability, acceptable coverage loss and resource budgets before activation; numbers remain unresolved, not implicit defaults.

Record bias, error distribution/limits of agreement, repeatability and recovery alongside capture-to-feedback latency, RSS, energy and setup effort. No improvement claim from correlation or high pose availability alone.

Do not conflate forearm inclination with IR or use a gravity-only upper-arm inclinometer as proof of in-bed-plane caudal alignment. References must measure both intended quantities with known definitions.

Existing RGB benchmark videos can test only recorded channels; synthetic depth/IMU tests transport/logic, not hardware benefit. Replays cannot establish battery, thermal, actual speech or human comprehension.

Fault interventions: missing/stale depth, timestamp drift, mirror/crop/lens changes, glare/occlusion, covered shaft, grip slip, helper intrusion, translation at fixed gravity, model switch, memory/thermal pressure and research-origin leakage.

Use only consented, permitted inputs. Keep a small approved RGB/reference subset for image-estimator debugging; landmark replay alone cannot explain inference hallucination. Retain compact ordinary records rather than routine images.
experiments.go_no_go: Retain an adjunct only if it improves prespecified clinically meaningful error/coverage or robustness without unacceptable burden/resource cost. If it fails, remove/defer it while retaining baseline and guided Do. A neutral/negative result is a legitimate endpoint, not reason to broaden the stack.

implementation_order.dod: Typed observation adapter + isolated acknowledged persistence + reopen/comparison. No estimator math, method self-registration, incoming saved-flag trust or patient leakage. Synthetic-to-live-study origin transition stays explicit.
implementation_order.stop: Independent review of source-bound positive/negative tests and real storage round trip; patient registry remains unchanged.

implementation_order.dod: Probe actual selected camera/format and permission state; establish coordinate/clock/generation contract and unavailable fields without new patient controls. Probe alone does not stream unnecessary sensors.
implementation_order.stop: Compiled adapter with fixture coverage; physical capability receipt separately needed before stating device support.

implementation_order.dod: Bounded compatibility spike: maintained V5 versus public same-owner extension versus deferred depth; exact dependency/rollback and one-session evidence.
implementation_order.stop: Choose one justified route; no broad framework rewrite solely for an optional feature.

implementation_order.dod: Motion/calibration, then optional depth/stick on the same reference-linked sequence; include all failure and missing-channel cases.
implementation_order.stop: Ablation evidence and useful-gain decision; absent consent/device/reference is a named blocker, not a fabricated pass.

implementation_order.dod: Approved method/allowance/display precision and physical/human evidence; keep knee/protocol delivery progressing independently. Stable provenance/API prepares later clinician integration without a portal now.
implementation_order.stop: Named independent/clinical acceptance before enabling numerical patient methods; no whole-gate acceptance by this document.
